reviews.text:
Made the switch to Ravenswood Animal Hospital for my cat when I moved into the area and I cannot recommend them enough. They are simultaneously organized, punctual, and efficient while still personable, patient, and communicative. Each time I needed support and advice, they gave detailed and individualized recommendations, also emailing recs for convenience and following up with a phone call a few days later.

When I was out of town for a month, my cat became sick and they worked hand in hand with my mom to give her the care and attention she needed. I full heartedly believe Dr Mitchell and all the staff here (in addition to my mom) are the only reason I got to see my cat again upon my return. I can never thank them enough for that. Putting her down was a hard decision, but their guidance, empathy, and focus on quality of life aided in those difficult decisions.

Thank you for all that you guys do. Should I ever adopt another animal in the future, I know where I will be taking them for care. ❤️
The best

Wonderful animal hospital. The doctors and staff took great care of dogs for nail trims when they tore their nails and needed bandages. These are our regular veterinarians and we always feel they take great care of our 2 dogs. Highly recommend! UPDATE: although we've added a third dog to our household, they all receive the same excellent care from the doctors and staff at RAH. Wouldn't go anywhere else for their care. Highly recommend!! They are wonderful!

Such a wonderful practice full of caring vets and staff who truly love your animals like their own. I always trusted in their recommendations and never felt like they were just out to make a quick buck. We took our two cats here for everything from routine vet visits to illness treatments to end of life care, and found the same compassion and care throughout.

I’ve been a client for years and I used to recommend them regularly for their pragmatic approach.
Admittedly, since PE firms have taken over vet practices, I have reevaluated my approach to preventative care and will take my happy, healthy dog in as needed.

Last week, my dog was seriously injured. They sent me to MedVet which is understandable. MedVet is basically an emergency room so they typically don’t refill meds and directed me back to Ravenswood. So I called and asked for a 3-day pain medication bridge until his orthopedic surgery appointment (they have last week’s labs already sent showing he was otherwise healthy), they refused unless I brought him in to “re-establish a relationship.”
My 70 lbs dog can barely walk. Denying a 3 day refill in this situation felt incredibly uncaring. I won’t be using or recommending this clinic anymore.
I used to love this place - my cat had dental surgery here about 7 years ago. It has really gone downhill since then.
Great service they have taken care of my cats and have done a wonderful job!

As three-time dog owners with family roots in the area going back to 1956— not kidding — we feel lucky to have found such a great vet for our best friends. The team is kind, efficient, and incredibly sharp at what they do. We highly recommend them and are genuinely grateful for the trust we have in their care.
Extremely kind and accommodating. Everyone who works here seems to be a compassionate animal lover. Thank you!

I am a dog trainer and I absolutely love this place - from the front desk staff, to the vet techs, to the veterinarians. They are understanding, compassionate, and knowledgable. They are great working with every type of animal - including the ones with some extra quirks. Their prices are fantastic, they are still locally owned business andddd they have parking!

I had a very upsetting experience with Ravenswood Animal Hospital and feel it’s important to share this for other pet owners.

My puppy Sora (born October 17, 2025) has been receiving her vaccines on schedule:
– December 4 (7 weeks)
– December 29 (11 weeks)
– January 28 (14 weeks)
– February 16 (rabies)

I made a conscious decision to separate her final booster and rabies vaccine due to potential reactions, which I communicated and planned for. However, before I had to travel, there was no proactive follow-up call or clear reminder to schedule her final booster, and this ended up being missed until March 24.

When I called in to book the appointment, I was left on hold for about 15 minutes, only to be told that she would now need two additional boosters. This was frustrating, especially given that the delay was not intentional and could have been easily prevented with a simple call — something the clinic has had no problem doing in the past for other, less urgent matters.

I was later told that reminders had been sent via email and mail. While I understand that may be part of their process, realistically most people do not rely on physical mail for time-sensitive medical reminders. What added to the frustration is that this clinic has previously called me directly for other things, so it’s unclear why that same level of communication wasn’t used here for something as important as a vaccine schedule.

What escalated the situation further was how it was handled afterward. I received a call from the head veterinarian two hours later — in the middle of my work meeting — and instead of addressing my concerns or offering any understanding, I was told that I had made their receptionist cry and was essentially dismissed as a client.

I want to be very clear: I did not swear, raise my voice aggressively, or direct personal anger toward the receptionist. I explicitly stated that I was frustrated with the situation, not with her. Being told that I made someone cry, and then being “fired” as a client over that, felt extremely disproportionate and unprofessional.

The tone of the conversation from the head vet came across as dismissive and condescending, with little effort to listen or de-escalate. There was no attempt to acknowledge the communication gap or work toward a reasonable solution.

As a pet owner, I take my dog’s health seriously and expect a veterinary clinic to act as a partner in that care — including clear communication, consistency, and professionalism. Unfortunately, this experience left me feeling unsupported, blamed, and ultimately disrespected.

I hope the clinic takes a closer look at how situations like this are handled in the future, both from a communication and customer service perspective.

I called this office for my dog who is severely sick and needed quick attention. The staff member I spoke with was upfront, considerate, and prepared with several resources for me to get my dog the care he needs. Every animal deserves the care and attention this office offers and I cannot thank them enough.

I can’t say enough nice things about Ravenswood Animal Hospital. Dr. Olsen and Dr. Mitchell and staff provided wonderful care to my American Bulldog Mix. They are are very friendly and the facility is clean, bright and modern.

Dr. Cindy Olsen,
I can’t thank you enough for the incredible care, compassion, and love you’ve shown Khloe — and me — through every step of this journey. You weren’t just her vet. You were her advocate, her protector, and one of the few people who truly understood how special she was and what she meant to me.

Your kindness has made one of the hardest moments of my life a little more bearable, and I will never forget the way you supported us with such dignity and empathy. Khloe adored you, and I adore you. I will always be grateful for you.

Thank you, truly, from the bottom of my heart.
Switched vets and was nervous about the switch...this place is nothing but amazing and I highly recommend.

We started taking our three cats to here this year and I am so thankful that we found them.

Our girls Eleanore and Margot had a very affordable, thorough routine checkup. Dr. Marisa Wlodek-Roesner took her time with the girls and was super friendly. The visit was $600 less than their visit last year which felt very rushed and cold.

Augie has some urinary issues which have been complex and stressful for him and us. Dr. Olsen, Dr. Key and Dr. Mitchell have taken such good care of him. He has a lot of anxiety and everyone is so patient and kind. They always call to check in on him and even called to check on him after he had to go to the emergency vet and stay for two days. They have gone above and beyond to fit him in twice as well. The support staff is absolutely incredible as well. Everyone is kind, supportive and so caring. I am so thankful to have a vet we can trust 100% and count on during challenging times.

I'm so happy we switched here a few years ago. Every vet, tech, and support person we have seen there has been so thorough, kind, thoughtful, friendly and then some. We really feel like they care for our babies.
Staff is super awesome. Best vet in the city
Super nice and helpful people. Great service for humans and pets

Avoid, if you don’t like people OK with animal cruelty. Ravenswood Animal Hospital refused to take accountability after my dog was injured during a visit and refused to provide basic guidance as my animals aged. Friends repeatedly warned I was being scammed by this vet, which seems to prioritize profits over pet care generally and many times recommended unnecessary costly tests i later felt foolish for approving. When I asked for a phone call to discuss my concerns after my dog was hurt due to a vet tech’s clear lack of confidence and unusual instincts to restrain a bigger dog, Dr. Olsen talked down to me while getting all the details wrong because she has never actually seen my animals and apparently is just the cop at the office. Dr. Olsen cruelly cut my cat off from medication because I demanded accountability and refused to let me talk to the vets who actually saw my animals. I will be filing a complaint with the Illinois licensing board and would warn anybody—the first red flag, trust your instincts and find a vet that’s not cruel. If they actually respond to this review, they will simply blame me for getting upset, which is extremely convenient when anybody would be upset by the mistreatment.
Outstanding vet clinic.  Totally recommend.   You can tell from the moment you walk in that they love animals.

10/10 My dog had surgery yesterday and the second I walked in I was greeted by the front desk and they knew exactly who Gnocchi was! As a nervous dog mom it was very comforting with how nice the staff is! Michaela is Dr. Niki’s assistant and I can’t rave enough about her. She was so kind made me laugh and made a nervous dog mom walk out of that office with a smile on my face because I knew he would be okay! Dr. Niki did an amazing job like I said she did the surgery yesterday and this morning the dog was at 90% his happy self this morning. 💕💕 I would recommend this place to anyone looking for a vet. Appreciate everyone there.

I absolutely love Ravenswood Animal Hospital — they are unfailingly kind and so considerate to both me and my 75-lb GSD/pit mix, and their post-visit follow-up calls & transparent billing practices were such a pleasant experience especially after having had a few less-than-great experiences with other vets. You won’t find a better or more compassionate veterinary office!

10/10 cannot recommend a better vet to you. I have a 4 year old French bulldog with some typical Frenchie issues so it is extremely important for me to have a thorough vet. I switched to Ravenswood after asking a good friend for a recommendation after having a not so great experience at another Chicago based vet clinic. I cannot express how happy I have been with the staff at Ravenswood- from the front desk to the wonderful tech that took over an hour with us at our first visit and Dr. Olson who has been so kind, patient and extremely thorough in combing through my dogs past medical records and getting a solid plan in place to help my guy. I thank Ravenswood from the bottom of my heart and am excited to be a part of their wonderful clinic. Thank you

I transferred over to Ravenswood Animal Hospital because it was closer to my new home, and I am very impressed with all the staff and the service. The front desk was so friendly and welcoming, the vet tech and veterinarian were friendly, welcoming, nice to my pup, and educated me a lot about everything during the appointment. I am glad I found this place! Love it
Best in Chicago
This is a best place to bring your dog's and cat's too. Ben coming here for years with my dogs. They're very nice and friendly definitely tell my friends and family about ravenswood animal hospital.

I have genuinely never been so impressed by a veterinary practice. My partner and I brought our new dog in today and the entire staff were amazing. From Laura and Phoebe at the front desk to Griff to Dr. Nikki, I am blown away by the kindness and professionalism they all displayed. Our pup was well cared for and I so appreciated their willingness to explain everything. I am so grateful to have found such a wonderful vet close to home!

The whole team is amazing- receptionists, vet techs, vets. My dog Pixie is tough to work on and they handle her so calmly and gentle. She’s had many random health issues from when I rescued her (she had very bad giardia when I got her) and sometimes her tummy will be sensitive- but they have always helped get her back on her feet. They are easy to schedule with and have taken us the same day for emergencies when we need it. Shoutout to vet tech/nurse Jen and Dr Olsen, they are superb. It’s rare to find a place this good.

Ravenswood Animal Hospital became part of our family during the many years they cared for our sweet Molly. She had many health issues in her golden years and we are convinced Ravenwood's team prolonged her life and improved her quality of life until the very end. They treated us with such care and kindness, always offering us options. They are fair priced and professional. We would not recommend anywhere else.

We have been going to Ravenswood Animal Hospital for just under 10 years. From regular checkups, to dealing with complicated health issues, the doctors and staff at Ravenswood have been nothing short of supportive. I would highly recommend this clinic.
The best in the biz! They take incredible care of my dog and are warm and welcoming.
Never been to a vet that is great as Ravenswood animal hospital. Staff Truly care about each and every single pet. Thank you guys!

The best vet experiences I’ve had in Chicago for our dogs.  The office is quick to respond with any questions and also do very thorough annual exam visits. I’ve met Dr Nikki the most and adore her but everyone we’ve met there has been top-notch.

Our recently adopted dog received heartworm treatment at Ravenwood Animal Hospital over the last few months. This is a very challenging treatment to go through and the veterinarians, technicians and staff at RAH took great care of our little dog. They thoroughly explained the treatment to us and checked up regularly on how our little dog was doing. We are so thankful for the expertise and compassion everyone at RAH provided to us and our dog! Thank you, RAH! It's no surprise that they are routinely voted as one of the top animal hospitals in the city!

My elder min pin/pug mix has been seeing Drs Nikki, Key, AND Mitchell for the last few years for routine visits and kidney disease monitoring/treatment. All 3 have stepped up and helped during emergencies, confusing times, and standard care.

But the staff has also shown incredible care. So much so that I could hear the techs cooing and calming my dog as she was anxiously fighting her last nail trim.

We originally switched from another vet close by after feeling discarded and uncared for, and have had the best treatment under Ravenswood Animal Hospital.

They've made me feel comfortable handing the tiny, 10-lb, love of my life over to their hands. No matter who it is in the clinic. Even with an impending move, I'll continue bringing my baby girl here.
The best vet clinic around! Everyone is so gentle and genuinely cares about the animals.

We've been going to Ravenswood Animal Hospital since our dog was 4 months old. They always do a great job of taking care of Frank and are transparent about different care options. I highly recommend anyone that owns a dog or cat to make Ravenswood Animal Hospital your primary Vet.
Dr. Marisa is fantastic. She spends as much time as she needs to make sure you understand what's going on and is incredibly empathetic.
I’ve taken my cat here for about 3-4 years, I’ve always gotten great service, they are honest and fair. Highly recommend!
